{{ModBox}} '''Hornet Strike''' is a [[mod]] that increases the base [[Damage]] of [[Secondary Weapons]] by 20% per rank, at a maximum of 220% at rank 10. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +20% || 4 |- | 1 || +40% || 5 |- | 2 || +60% || 6 |- | 3 || +80% || 7 |- | 4 || +100% || 8 |- | 5 || +120% || 9 |- | 6 || +140% || 10 |- | 7 || +160% || 11 |- | 8 || +180% || 12 |- | 9 || +200% || 13 |- | 10 || +220% || 14 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 2 |- | 1 || +20% || 3 |- | 2 || +30% || 4 |- | 3 || +40% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== *An unranked Hornet Strike is given upon completion of [[The Teacher]] Quest. {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Base damage bonuses are multiplied against the base damage of the weapon. **For example, a weapon with a base damage of 100 would deal 320 damage when modded with a max-rank Hornet Strike equipped: {{MathText|100 {{mul}} (1 + 2.2) {{eql}} 320}}. *Base damage bonuses are also multiplied against added elemental damage. **For example, a weapon with a base damage of 100, modded with {{M|Deep Freeze}} would deal 190 damage. Adding a max-rank Hornet Strike would apply a 220% damage bonus to both the base and elemental damage, resulting in 608 damage with both mods installed: {{MathText|100 {{mul}} (1 + 0.9) {{mul}} (1 + 2.2) {{eql}} 608}}. *The high effect of Hornet Strike when combined with elemental damage mods makes it a frequent choice for secondary weapons where the goal is to deal as much damage as possible. Hornet Strike is available from the nearly the beginning of the game, making it a reliable mod choice and a good investment of {{Resource|Endo}} during the [[Star Chart]] section of the game. **Although larger buffs (like those created by {{Arcane|Cascadia Flare}} and {{M|Galvanized Shot}}) can outperform Hornet Strike, those won't be available until significant progress into the later portion of the game has been made, and operate via more involved mechanics. *When more than one damage bonus is present, they are merely added together, not multiplied. **For example, a weapon with a base damage of 100 with a max-rank Hornet Strike equipped would deal only a small amount more when {{M|Pistol Amp}} (+27% Pistol Damage) is equipped: {{MathText|100 {{mul}} (1 + 2.2 + 0.27) {{eql}} 347}}. ==Gallery== HornetStrikeModOld.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.2}} *Fixed Drop Location text overlapping in the Codex when viewing the following Mods: **Hornet Strike {{ver|8.1.3}} *Fixed Hornet Strike not affecting DOT from the Acrid. {{ver|Vanilla}} *Introduced. }} {{DamageModsNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Hornissenstich]] [[es:Golpe de avispa]] [[pt:Hornet Strike]] [[ru:Удар Осы]] [[fr:Nuée de Dards]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Damage Mods]] [[Category:Madurai Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Напад шершня]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}} '''Fast Hands''' is a rifle [[mod]] that increases [[reload speed]]. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +5% || 2 |- | 1 || +10% || 3 |- | 2 || +15% || 4 |- | 3 || +20% || 5 |- | 4 || +25% || 6 |- | 5 || +30% || 7 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +3% || 2 |- | 1 || +6% || 3 |- | 2 || +9% || 4 |- | 3 || +12% || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *The calculation of reload time using reload speed is: {{MathText|Reload Time {{eql}} Base Reload Time {{div}} (1 + Reload Speed Bonus)}} **At max rank, a +30% reload speed bonus reduces reload times by about 23%. *On Bow type weapons such as the {{Weapon|Paris}}, Fast Hands increases the notching speed of the arrow. ==Trivia== *Prior to {{ver|16.7}}, this mod was usable in [[PvP]] games until it was replaced by its own specific PvP mods along with a number of other mods: {{M|Quickdraw}}, {{M|Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Stabilizer}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, {{M|Magazine Warp}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}. *The weapon being held by {{WF|Ember}} as shown in the mod is the {{Weapon|Braton Vandal}}. ==Gallery== FastHandsModOld.png|Old appearance ==See also== *{{M|Tactical Pump}}, the shotgun version of this mod. *{{M|Quickdraw}}, the sidearm version of this mod. *{{M|Primed Fast Hands}}, the [[Prime]] version of this mod. *{{M|Depleted Reload}}, the Corrupted version of this mod for snipers. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|16.7}} * The following mods have been disabled in PvP: {{M|Magazine Warp}}, {{M|Slip Magazine}}, {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, {{M|Stabilizer}}, {{M|Steady Hands}}, Fast Hands, {{M|Quickdraw}}, {{M|Tactical Pump}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}. They have been replaced with PvP specific versions that have been added to the Mission Rewards of all PvP game types. }} {{ReloadSpeedModsNav}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Schnelle Hände]] [[es:Manos rápidas]] [[pt:Fast Hands]] [[ru:Быстрые Руки]] [[fr: Mains Rapides]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Common Mods]] [[Category:Rifle Mods]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Швидкі руки]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}} The '''Hellfire''' mod increases {{D|Heat}} damage by 15% per rank for a maximum of 90% at rank 5. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mods#Mod Power Cost|Cost]] |- | 0 || +15% || 6 |- | 1 || +30% || 7 |- | 2 || +45% || 8 |- | 3 || +60% || 9 |- | 4 || +75% || 10 |- | 5 || +90% || 11 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mods#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mods#Mod Power Cost|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 4 |- | 1 || +20% || 5 |- | 2 || +30% || 6 |- | 3 || +40% || 7 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Though dropped infrequently, it can be obtained as a reward from [[Dark Sector]] defense missions. *There is a relatively easy way to farm this on the [[Kuva Fortress]] tile set. In many end rooms, there are Latcher Turrets that will deploy 2 waves of 8 [[Latcher]]s when your warframe is detected by the scanners. An AoE weapon such as {{Weapon|Ignis}} or a weapon that chains like {{Weapon|Atomos}} can make quick work of the [[Latcher]]s and you can repeat this infinitely. The turret will retreat into the ground after deploying its second wave, you can spawn it again by being scanned another time. ==Gallery== HellfireU11.png|Old appearance {{ElementMods}} [[es:Fuego infernal]] [[de:Höllenfeuer]] [[ru:Адское Пламя]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Heat Damage]] [[Category:Rifle Mods]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Пекельний вогонь]] [[Category:Update 14]]

[[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || +10% || 4 |- | 1 || +20% || 5 |- | 2 || +30% || 6 |- | 3 || +40% || 7 |} ==Drop Locations== *An unranked Heated Charge is given upon completion of [[The Teacher]] Quest. {{DropLocations}} ==Tips== *{{D|Heat}} damage is exceptionally effective against [[Infested]]. **Due to the nature of Infested's strategy, namely charging in numbers, it is recommended to apply this mod on Shotgun-type pistols like the {{Weapon|Bronco}} and the {{Weapon|Detron}} as they spread multiple pellets widely, effectively applying damage on multiple enemies. *It is rewarded frequently on [[defense]] missions . ==Gallery== HeatedChargeU11.png|Old appearance {{Clr}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|0}} *Introduced }} ==See also== *{{M|Primed Heated Charge}}, the Prime version. {{ElementMods}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Flammenladung]] [[es:Carga incendiaria]] [[ru:Горячий Заряд]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Heat Damage]] [[Category:Naramon Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]] [[uk:Пекельний заряд]] [[Category:Update 14]]

{{ModBox}} '''Expel Grineer''' is a [[mod]] that increases the [[Faction Damage]] of pistols against {{Faction|Grineer}}. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |+ Normal |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || x1.05 || 4 |- | 1 || x1.1 || 5 |- | 2 || x1.15 || 6 |- | 3 || x1.2 || 7 |- | 4 || x1.25 || 8 |- | 5 || x1.3 || 9 |}
{| class="emodtable" |+ [[Flawed Mods|Flawed]] |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Effect ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || x1.03 || 2 |- | 1 || x1.05 || 3 |- | 2 || x1.08 || 4 |- | 3 || x1.1 || 5 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *Has no effect on {{Faction|Corrupted}} and {{Faction|Narmer}} Grineer (e.g. {{E|Corrupted Lancer}}, {{E|Narmer Lancer}}). *Despite being listed as a multiplier, it will stack '''additively''' with other sources of Damage to Grineer. **For example, if you had a [[Riven Mods|Riven Mod]] with x0.5 Damage to Grineer and a max rank Expel Grineer with x1.3 Damage to Grineer, you would have a '''1 - 0.5 + 0.3 = x0.8''' multiplier for damage against Grineer with both mods equipped. ==Gallery== ExpelGrineerModOld.png|Old appearance ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|34.0}} *Changed the Faction Damage Mod (includes Bane, Cleanse, Expel, Smite, Railjack, and Riven Faction Stats) descriptions to use multiplier instead of percentage based stat formatting. Damage values have not changed! Just the way they are communicated. **For example: Smite Corpus (at max rank) ***Was: “+30% Damage to Corpus.” ***Now: “x1.3 Damage to Corpus.” **This change better communicates how Faction Damage is calculated, since calculation occurs when you hit the enemy, as opposed to when you shoot like other damage sources (since it needs to know what Faction is being hit). For that reason, multipliers apply to final damage as a whole and not just part of the formula! {{ver|9.0}} *12x new Mods: ''[[Faction Damage Mods|Faction "Bane"]]'' (melee, pistol, shotgun, rifle). *Introduced }} {{FactionMods}} __NOTOC__ [[de:Grineer Verjagen]] [[es:Expeler grineer]] [[fr:Expulse-Grineers]] [[pt:Expel Grineer]] [[ru:Изгнание: Гринир]] [[uk:Відстріл ґрінерів]] [[Category:Mods]] [[Category:Pistol Mods]] [[Category:Faction Damage Mods]] [[Category:Uncommon Mods]] [[Category:Update 9]] [[Category:Madurai Mods]] [[Category:Flawed Mods]]
